build_motion_planner: build a MotionPlanner instance with a RearrangeSim and CfgNode config to plan robot arm motion
run_motion_plan: run motion_plan on a MotionPlanner with start joint states and a RobotTarget to get a collision-free joint trajectory
create_state_validity_check: create a state validity check using _is_state_valid to verify if a joint configuration is collision free
configure_motion_planning_params: configure motion planning parameters via set_config to set EE margin, grasp threshold, and collision counting options
render_debug_motion_plan: render a debug video of a motion plan using _render_verify_motion_plan to visualize and validate joint states
